recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-17511 unless BR&R opens a new tracker to update the BRIDG version or mapping content.
issue_request: FHIR-17511 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 change request from BR&R asking that BRIDG 5.1 mappings be included for ResearchStudy and ResearchSubject because BRIDG is the official DAM for BR&R. The Jira resolution says those mappings were added and published in the current build.
initial_application: The issue was applied before this reconciliation: commit a89b85b64a240b1301ecb177035bc6d7c9477ec1 added the BRIDG 5.1 mapping space and ResearchStudy spreadsheet mappings while explicitly naming Tracker 17511, and commit c01078fb2058c6adb493c7548cf4997f170ec76f added the matching ResearchSubject spreadsheet mappings. The 2021 source rework commit 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 preserved those BRIDG5.1 mappings when the resource sources moved from spreadsheets to StructureDefinition XML.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists ResearchStudy and ResearchSubject as active build resources. source/mappingSpaces.xml still publishes the BRIDG5.1 mapping space. Current ResearchStudy XML has 24 BRIDG5.1 identity entries and current ResearchSubject XML has 10. Zulip and Confluence searches found no later conflicting decision; a 2017 biopharma Zulip thread is consistent with ResearchStudy and ResearchSubject BRIDG work already being prepared in the current build before the formal tracker was filed.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source edit was necessary because the current build-scoped source already contains the requested mappings for both resources.

related_jiras.note: Mentioned in the same 2018 ResearchStudy application commit, but it concerns a separate ResearchStudy.condition correction and was not decided here.
